title: Mortal Kombat Komplete Edition

modes.name: One vs One
modes.description: The classic one-on-one fight. Both players pick their fighter on the game's own select screen.

modes.name: Two vs Two
modes.description: Tag team fight: each player picks two fighters on the game's select screen and tags between them.

modes.name: Test Your Luck
modes.description: One vs One with random modifiers rolled on the slot machine before the fight. Kasual only.

modes.name: Practice
modes.description: Offline on this PC: the whole game with its own menus (Single player).

not_on_xbox.name: Kratos
not_on_xbox.note: PlayStation 3 and PS Vita versions only; the Xbox 360 disc has no Kratos

notes: Komplete Edition on Xbox 360: the 27 fighters of the original Xbox 360 release (Cyber Sub-Zero is unlocked in the game) and the four downloadable ones on the disc (Skarlet, Kenshi, Rain, Freddy Krueger). Goro, Kintaro and Shao Kahn are the bosses; the disc has their fights and fatalities, but they are not on the regular select screen. Fighters are picked on the game's own select screen; the ids are what a start line's p1/p2 would name.
sources: game/filelist.txt (the disc's Asset folder: a <Name>_Ladder.xxx for each fighter of the select screen, fatalities for the bosses)
